sections.heading: 1. AGREEMENT
sections.text: This Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on this 11/01/2026 , by and between Elevated Ventures EG, LLC d/b/a 513Sips ("Service Provider") and Synthetic Client: Evers LOW, full bar for all staff ("Client").

sections.heading: 2. EVENT DETAILS
sections.text: Event Date: 2026-11-21 Event Type: Synthetic Event Venue: Synthetic Venue Venue Contact: Synthetic Venue Contact Venue Contact Phone: 513-555-0101 Venue Address: 100 Test Avenue, Cincinnati, OH 45202 Service Start Time: 18:00 Service End Time: 22:00 Expected Guest Count: 200 Service Hours: 4

sections.heading: 3. SERVICES PROVIDED
sections.text: 513Sips provides mobile bar services as outlined in the selected package. This includes professional bartending, setup, takedown, and agreed-upon mixers or décor. Dry-Hire Service: 513Sips does not make any profit from alcohol sales. The Client maintains full control over alcohol selection, quantity, and budget. 513Sips is not responsible for purchasing too much or too little alcohol, and all alcohol remains Client's property before, during, and after the event. By default, Client is responsible for purchasing and transporting all alcoholic beverages in compliance with Ohio law. However, Client may purchase the Alcohol Procurement Add-On, in which case 513Sips will shop for alcohol on Client's behalf using Client's provided budget. Alcohol will be purchased at cost with receipts provided; 513Sips charges only a flat service fee for this convenience. All service packages include: insured and certified bartenders, complete bar setup and breakdown, bar tools, and equipment. Glassware may be included depending on package selected. Ice, mixers, garnish, and syrup-making ingredients are billed to Client at cost, with receipts provided and no markup, as described in Section 12 below. 513Sips' service fee covers the labor of sourcing, preparing, and staging these items, not the cost of the products themselves. This dry-hire structure ensures full legal compliance with Ohio liquor laws while providing the convenience of professional bartending service. Package Details: Full Bar Package, 2 Signature Cocktails, Glassware Service, Bar Equipment & Accessories Contract Notes:

sections.heading: 4. PAYMENT TERMS
sections.text: Total Amount: $4,321 50% non-refundable deposit: $2,161 due at signing to secure the date. Remaining balance: $2,160 due 14 days prior to the event. Late Payments: Subject to a 15% late fee. Payment Methods: Check, Venmo, Zelle, or Cash. No credit cards accepted. Non-Payment: If balance is not paid by 7 days prior, 513Sips may cancel with no refund of deposit.

sections.heading: 5. PRICING BREAKDOWN
sections.text: Base Package (1 bartender, first 3 hrs, up to 50 guests): $650 Additional Bartenders (3 additional bartenders, first 3 hrs): $675 High-Volume Adjustment: $250 Extended Service Hours (+1 hr × 4 bartenders): $300 Full Bar Service (4 hrs × 4 bartenders): $240 Glassware: $1,806 Signature Cocktails (2): $250 Bar Equipment & Accessories: $150

sections.heading: 6. SETUP & TAKEDOWN
sections.text: Arrival is approximately 90 minutes before service for bar assembly and preparation. Takedown occurs within 30–45 minutes after service ends. Client must provide safe, unobstructed access, adequate lighting, and a clear load-in path. Delays caused by venue or Client (locked doors, setup delays, etc.) incur a $50/hour waiting fee (billed in 15-minute increments). Bartending hours begin when guest service starts.

sections.heading: 7. OVERTIME, EXTENSIONS & EARLY ARRIVAL
sections.text: Events extending past contracted hours are billed at 1.5x the standard rate ($112.50/hour per bartender), in full-hour increments. Overtime must be approved by Client onsite and paid before takedown or invoiced post-event. Early arrival requested beyond the standard 90-minute setup window is billed at 1.3x the standard rate ($100/hour per bartender).

sections.heading: 8. TRAVEL & MILEAGE
sections.text: Travel within 30 miles round-trip from downtown Cincinnati (45202) is included at no charge. Additional mileage: 31–60 miles round-trip: +$40 61–100 miles round-trip: +$75 100+ miles round-trip: Custom quote required

sections.heading: 9. DAMAGE & MISSING EQUIPMENT
sections.text: Client is responsible for any loss, theft, or damage to 513Sips property during the event. Replacement values: Glassware: $6 per item Décor: $25–$150 per item Bar Tools: $25 each Tent: $400 Bar Cart: $1,800 Damage will be documented with photos and invoiced within five (5) business days. Payment is due within seven (7) days.

sections.heading: 10. CANCELLATION POLICY
sections.text: 10+ days before event: 75% refund (less deposit) 5–9 days before event: 50% refund (less deposit) Day of event or less than 5 days: No refund All cancellations must be submitted in writing. If 513Sips must cancel due to emergency, injury, illness, or force majeure, all payments (including deposit) will be refunded in full.

sections.heading: 11. INCLEMENT WEATHER
sections.text: Client is responsible for providing weather protection (covered area or tent rental). If weather creates unsafe conditions and no covered area exists, 513Sips may pause or cancel service without refund.

sections.heading: 12. ALCOHOL, MIXERS & PRODUCTS
sections.text: Alcohol Procurement: Unless Client has purchased the Alcohol Procurement Add-On, Client is responsible for purchasing and transporting all alcohol. Quantity guidance provided by 513Sips is a good-faith estimate only. 513Sips is not liable for shortages or overages. If Alcohol Procurement Add-On is selected, 513Sips will shop for alcohol on Client's behalf using Client's budget. All alcohol is purchased at cost with receipts provided. Unused alcohol remains Client's property. Ice, Mixers, Garnish & Syrup Materials: 513Sips sources ice, mixers, garnish, and syrup-making ingredients for every event. These are pass-through costs, billed to Client at cost with receipts provided, no markup. If Client has purchased the Alcohol Procurement Add-On, these costs are combined into the prepaid procurement budget alongside alcohol. If Client has not purchased the Add-On, these costs are billed separately at cost. Separate service fees (e.g. ice coordination, signature cocktail development) may apply and cover labor only, never the cost of the product itself. Mixers & Homemade Products: All mixers, syrups, and purees are prepared safely. Client must notify 513Sips of any allergies 14 days in advance. 513Sips is not liable for allergic reactions not disclosed in writing. Licensing: Client must confirm the venue permits outside bartending services. 513Sips reserves the right to cancel with full refund if venue restrictions prevent lawful service.

sections.heading: 13. AGE VERIFICATION & GUEST CONDUCT
sections.text: 513Sips will not serve anyone under 21 or visibly intoxicated. 513Sips may refuse service at its discretion. Client is responsible for guest conduct and any incidents arising from alcohol consumption.

sections.heading: 14. INSURANCE
sections.text: Service Provider maintains general liability and liquor liability insurance per event. Certificate of Insurance available upon request.

sections.heading: 15. INDEMNIFICATION (PROTECTION FOR 513SIPS)
sections.text: Client agrees to protect 513Sips from any claims, damages, or legal costs that arise from: Alcohol service or consumption at the event Guest behavior or injuries Property damage Venue hazards or problems Failure to follow laws or venue policies This means if someone gets hurt, damages property, or files a lawsuit related to the event, Client will cover 513Sips' legal costs and any settlements.

sections.heading: 16. FORCE MAJEURE
sections.text: Neither party is liable for delay or failure to perform due to events beyond reasonable control (severe weather, natural disasters, illness, injury, government restrictions, etc.).

sections.heading: 17. PHOTOGRAPHY & MARKETING RELEASE
sections.text: Client grants 513Sips permission to photograph or film the bar setup and service for marketing use. No identifiable guest images will be used without permission.

sections.heading: 18. VENUE ACKNOWLEDGMENT
sections.text: Client must provide venue contact information and confirm the venue permits outside bartending services. The venue must acknowledge 513Sips as an approved vendor. 513Sips reserves the right to cancel with full refund if venue restrictions prevent lawful service.

sections.heading: 19. SUBCONTRACTORS
sections.text: 513Sips may utilize subcontracted bartenders. All subcontractors are trained, certified, and operate under 513Sips supervision.

sections.heading: 20. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
sections.text: Any dispute shall first attempt mediation in Hamilton County, Ohio. If mediation fails, binding arbitration applies.

sections.heading: 21. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
sections.text: This Agreement contains the entire understanding between the Parties. Any modification must be in writing and signed by both Parties.

sections.heading: 22. SIGNATURES
sections.text: By signing below, both parties agree to the terms of this Agreement. If Client has not purchased the Add-On, these costs are billed separately at cost. Separate service fees (e.g. ice coordination, signature cocktail development) may apply and cover labor only, never the cost of the product itself. Mixers & Homemade Products: All mixers, syrups, and purees are prepared safely. Client must notify 513Sips of any allergies 14 days in advance. 513Sips is not liable for allergic reactions not disclosed in writing. PHOTOGRAPHY & MARKETING RELEASE Client grants 513Sips permission to photograph or film the bar setup and service for marketing use. No identifiable guest images will be used without permission. 18. VENUE ACKNOWLEDGMENT Client must provide venue contact information and confirm the venue permits outside bartending services. SUBCONTRACTORS 513Sips may utilize subcontracted bartenders. All subcontractors are trained, certified, and operate under 513Sips supervision. 20.
